description: This PHP class 'ProviderRepository' manages retrieval and caching of oEmbed provider data, including fetching from remote URL, handling cache expiration, and fallback to stale data if needed.

classes.name: ProviderRepository
classes.description: Manages fetching and caching of oEmbed provider data, with methods to retrieve all providers or a specific provider by name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ProviderRepository with dependencies such as HTTP client, config, time, key-value store, logger, and cache duration.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all oEmbed providers, fetching from remote if cache is expired or missing, with fallback to stale data on error.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a specific provider by name, throws exception if not found.
